mapper.select: select as period, count(*) as totalCalls, sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as answeredCalls, sum(case when status = '3' then 1 else 0 end) as missedCalls, sum(case when status = '2' then 1 else 0 end) as transferredCalls, round(sum(case when status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) * 100, 2) as answerRate, ifnull(round(avg(case when status = '1' then duration end), 0), 0) as avgDurationSec from ai_call_record where call_time >= #{beginTime} and call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by period order by period

select cr.agent_id as agentId, ifnull(a.agent_name, concat('坐席', cr.agent_id)) as agentName, count(*) as totalCalls, sum(case when cr.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as answeredCalls, round(sum(case when cr.status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) * 100, 2) as answerRate, ifnull(round(avg(case when cr.status = '1' then cr.duration end), 0), 0) as avgDurationSec, ifnull(sum(case when cr.status = '1' then cr.duration else 0 end), 0) as totalTalkSec from ai_call_record cr left join ai_call_agent_status a on cr.agent_id = a.agent_id where cr.call_time >= #{beginTime} and cr.call_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) and cr.agent_id is not null group by cr.agent_id, a.agent_name order by totalCalls desc

select as period, count(*) as inspections, ifnull(round(avg(total_score), 2), 0) as avgScore, sum(case when review_status = '1' then 1 else 0 end) as reviewedCount, sum(case when review_status = '0' or review_status is null then 1 else 0 end) as pendingCount, sum(case when risk_warning_id is not null then 1 else 0 end) as riskCount from ai_quality_inspection where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by period order by period

select as period, count(*) as totalTickets, sum(case when status in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end) as closedTickets, round(sum(case when status in ('2', '3') then 1 else 0 end) / count(*) * 100, 2) as closeRate, sum(case when overtime_flag = 1 then 1 else 0 end) as overdueTickets, ifnull(round(avg(case when status in ('2', '3') and close_time is not null then timestampdiff(SECOND, create_time, close_time) end) / 60, 1), 0) as avgCloseMinutes from ai_call_ticket where create_time >= #{beginTime} and create_time < date_add(#{endTime}, interval 1 day) group by period order by period
